derived_from: fixture source authored in the same change, read directly

files_to_add.why: New ExportPlugin implementation. Must import from ../contracts/plugin.js only and read bucket/prefix/endpoint from PluginContext.settings.

files_to_change.why: builtInPlugins() is the single registration point for built-in plugins; the new plugin is constructed and returned there.

files_that_must_not_change.why: Adding an object-storage-specific method or field widens the extension surface, which the prompt forbids.
Registration is name-based and already generic; a new plugin needs no registry change.
Enablement flows through HostConfig.enabledPlugins and the EXPORT_PLUGINS environment override, both of which are already name-driven.

reference_plan.enablement: The plugin runs only when its name appears in HostConfig.enabledPlugins or in the EXPORT_PLUGINS environment override. No code change is required to make that possible.
optional: Implement dispose() to flush or close the storage client, since runExportLifecycle calls dispose on every initialized plugin.

critical_facts.statement: builtInPlugins() in src/host/plugin-host.ts is the only place a built-in plugin is registered.
The new plugin must depend on src/contracts/plugin.ts only, following CsvExportPlugin rather than WebhookExportPlugin.
Plugin configuration arrives through PluginContext.settings, which PluginHost.contextFor scopes per plugin name.

correct_uncertainty.requirement: The workspace has no object-storage client and no runtime dependencies at all. A plan must either introduce one explicitly as a new dependency or state that the transport is left abstract; silently assuming an SDK is already available is wrong.
The workspace contains no test files, so a plan that claims existing tests will cover the change is unsupported.

unsupported_claim_traps.claim: Add an ObjectStorage-specific method, option, or field to the ExportPlugin interface.
unsupported_claim_traps.why_false: That widens the extension surface, which the prompt forbids, and would force every existing plugin to change.

unsupported_claim_traps.claim: PluginRegistry must be modified to know about the new plugin.
unsupported_claim_traps.why_false: register() and resolve() are name-based and already generic.

unsupported_claim_traps.claim: Follow WebhookExportPlugin and read host configuration directly with resolveHostConfig.
unsupported_claim_traps.why_false: That is the seeded boundary violation; copying it reintroduces a wrong-direction dependency.

must_not_report_ready_when: src/host/plugin-host.ts is absent from the evidence set

hidden_acceptance_test.blocking_reason: An executable hidden acceptance test must be authored and held by a person other than the production-rule author. In the current single-author context it cannot be produced credibly. Until it exists the bounded-implementation score for this task is not_measured and only the plan rubric is scored.
hidden_acceptance_test.human_action_required: A second maintainer authors an acceptance test asserting that a new plugin can be added by touching exactly src/plugins/<new>.ts and builtInPlugins(), and stores it outside this repository per holdout-policy.md.
